original_test_intent.statement: Exercise every front-side storage bay for 12 hours at 40 C and +5% rail margin and detect storage or platform instability.
must_preserve: Every front-side bay, 40 C, +5% rails and 12-hour stress.
unknowns: Drive/bay map, destructive versus non-destructive SST mode, data ownership, workload, expected health/performance and timing conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It correctly stops undefined I/O, but BLOCKED describes missing handoff semantics rather than the enduring capability; the physical fixture makes this MANUAL ONLY even after inputs arrive.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No storage I/O is ready. Reclassify capability to MANUAL ONLY because the eventual test necessarily uses operator-controlled chamber/rails; missing workload and acceptance remain readiness blockers.

revision_candidate.test_name: Stress All Front-Side Storage at 40 C and +5% Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the owner-approved 12-hour workload on every mapped front-side storage device under controlled margin and verify declared data-integrity, health, error and performance criteria.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact server storage topology in a calibrated 40 C/+5% rail setup with supported SST/storage stack.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Each signed front bay and its stable enclosure/slot/controller/namespace identity; exclude boot, production, RAID-member and unapproved devices.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Bay-to-device map, data ownership, non-destructive or disposable-target method, SST profile, parallelism, 12-hour/240-minute resolution, thresholds, capacity/thermal limits, restoration and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read-only inventory is allowed now. After owner resolution, operator sets the environment and the agent may run only the signed workload against verified disposable targets, collecting per-bay evidence without clearing logs.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Identity interlocks prove every target, backups/RAID policy are satisfied, fixture and OOB recovery are ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Bay/enclosure/serial/controller/namespace mapping; target ownership; exact workload/version/parameters; 12-hour per-bay output; SMART/NVMe/SAS/controller/kernel/SEL deltas; chamber/rail telemetry; integrity results and nominal restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Owner-defined zero-error/integrity and performance/health thresholds for every bay; setup completion is never a PASS criterion.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No raw or protected device I/O, guessed bay mapping, log clearing, reduced duration, unapproved destructive mode or remote fixture control.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage owner signs targets/method; lab operator controls physical margin; engineer disposes results.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Environment is manual; bounded per-target workload can be automated after interlocks.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop I/O, preserve evidence, restore nominal environment, verify filesystem/array/device health and follow storage recovery without writes to uncertain targets.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any target ambiguity, missing acceptance, fixture drift, medium/controller/kernel/SEL error, integrity mismatch, overheating, device loss or incomplete evidence.

reason_for_change: The missing recipe makes current execution unsafe, but once supplied the irreducible chamber and rail manipulation—not semantic unknowability—sets the MANUAL ONLY capability class.
removed_ambiguities: Bay identity and data ownership are mandatory interlocks.
remaining_blockers: Source acceptance and workload are unresolved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves the no-I/O gate yet identifies the correct enduring class, exposes the time conflict, and turns the repeated setup text into an explicit engineering-decision requirement rather than a fictitious criterion.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved every-bay scope, 12-hour duration, 40 C/+5% conditions, stable storage identity, no undefined I/O and no setup-as-PASS interpretation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 6 names every front-side disk and 12-hour SST but its criterion is only the four procedure steps.
